name: Faun
publication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
sourceDistinctions: The printed Faun creature class and Table 4 stay linked by their exact name. PC1 p. 11 also calls fauns satyrs and the oldest ones sileni. This edition-specific profile is grouped under the catalog’s Satyr species.
PC1 gives no numeric range or lingering duration for impulse music. The sample adjudicates audibility at the table and uses the Rod/Staff/Spell saving throw for both participants.
